blocks.text: Incident: no-start after a battery jump with loose ground

This is the working cut for RDW-INC-2022-041 on October 11, 2022. Nina Soto asked for a written bound after the current path (Jumper pack is the first tool) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host bay-04.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on jump first, look later, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Inspect ground and cables before a jump. Clean, torque, then test. Do not jump a green ground twice. I am not restating a hallway yes. jump first, look later is out because Two jumps cooked a cable. Truck still clicked. Ground was the job. 1.6 hours wasted. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: jumps=2, hours=1.6, bay=4, weeks=1, click=1, green=1, torque=12, pack=1. Sibling tickets RDW-2280 and RDW-SOP-2022-055. I will not reopen jump first, look later in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
